About.title: About HWENDOXI
About.intro: HWENDOXI is a pan-African digital platform dedicated to the preservation, protection, documentation and transmission of African spiritual knowledge and pharmacopoeia.

sections.title: Our mission
sections.body: To document and promote ancestral African knowledge, make it easier to find information and profiles, and help protect communities against abuse, misconduct and identity impersonation.

sections.title: Our four pillars
sections.body:
Protection: protecting communities against abuse and impersonation.
Preservation: documenting and promoting ancestral knowledge.
Transmission: passing on knowledge with respect for traditions and communities.
Verification: offering a transparent directory whose files are reviewed.

sections.title: What “verified” means
sections.body: The verification status only certifies that certain information has been reviewed under HWENDOXI’s procedures. It does not certify spiritual powers, the results of consultations or the effectiveness of a medicinal practice. The absence of a profile or number in the directory is never proof of fraud.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This page explains what data is collected on HWENDOXI, why, and how to exercise your rights.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: For a listing: identity, country and city, professional and spiritual information, contact details, photograph, identity document. For a report: your message and, if you wish, your email.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: To review listing requests, publish only authorised information in the directory, protect communities against impersonation and process reports.

sections.title: Consent and publication
sections.body: No information is published without the explicit consent of the person concerned. You choose, item by item, what may be made public. Your email is never published.

sections.title: Identity documents
sections.body: They are used only for verification, are never published, can only be viewed by authorised verifiers, and are deleted after the committee’s decision.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction, withdrawal or deletion of your data at any time. Contact: [to be completed].
